threat_event: Memory-scraping malware reaches POS lanes through a connected network
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: In-store counter bench network reachable from lanes at 112 stores; processor encryption is not a validated P2PE solution, so lanes are in scope
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-D3 POS lanes; SYS-D4 store networks
existing_controls: EMV PIN pads with processor encryption; EDR on lanes; annual segmentation test
treatment_plan: Separate counter networks at the 112 stores; semiannual segmentation tests

threat_event: Checkout scripts are tampered with to skim card data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Change detection alerts reviewed weekly; marketing tags can load on checkout
treatment_plan: Payment-pages-only tag container; real-time alerts to the SOC

threat_event: Customer accounts are taken over and stored value or orders stolen
treatment_plan: Passkeys; step-up for payment token use

threat_event: Trade-in identity records are kept longer than needed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Trade-in records kept 7 years for all sellers
treatment_plan: Shorten retention to the period counsel confirms

threat_event: Ransomware hits store systems or the colocation payment switch
existing_controls: EDR; immutable backups; offline lane mode
treatment_plan: Quarterly restore tests of store back office servers

threat_event: PIN pads are tampered with or swapped
treatment_plan: Inspections at every store; spot audits

threat_event: A trade-in device returns to resale without a sanitization certificate
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Certificate linked in the trade-in system, but the resale check is manual
treatment_plan: Block resale listing without a certificate ID

threat_event: An incident misses the acquirer's 24-hour notice term
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Term known to the retail CISO; not in the group matrix for counter-originated incidents

threat_event: Loyalty marketing statements do not match data practices
AI fraud scoring or personalization treats customers unfairly
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Return fraud model blocks returns without a human review path at 20 stores
treatment_plan: Human review of every blocked return; quarterly outcome review

threat_event: Guest Wi-Fi users reach store systems
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Guest network separated; tested each year

threat_event: Gift card numbers are guessed or drained
Protection plan enrollment data is exposed in transfer to the TPA
Unauthorized changes are made on the payment switch
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Change control and file integrity monitoring

threat_event: CCTV footage of customers is exposed
treatment_plan: Accepted at Low; no facial recognition (group decision)

threat_event: Delivery and installation partners misuse customer address data
DDoS takes the website down on a launch day
